==Description==
The '''Cash Shot Buff''' was a buff that decreased the [[Cowboy]]'s cash shot. This meant it took the [[Cowboy]] less shots to generate cash. This buff is no longer used as it has been replaced by golden perks.

==Mechanics==
The following tower(s) used to have the '''Cash Shot Buff''':
*{{Color|Golden}} [[Cowboy]] (Passive)

==Update Log==
*'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]]
**'''Cash Shot Buff''' added.
*'''13 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.2]]
**'''Cash Shot Buff''' removed.
